title: AARYA Voice Lab Public Dataset Registry Record
description: One entry describing a public/third-party licensed dataset considered or approved for training-pipeline development, model experimentation, generic voice development, or benchmark development (see docs/DATA_POLICY.md). This registry is exclusively for the PUBLIC LICENSED DATA track. It must never hold synthetic test fixtures or consented real-person (target-speaker) data -- those tracks are recorded and governed elsewhere (schemas/enrollment_profile.schema.json, dataset_gate.py, docs/PRIVACY.md) and must never be mixed with this registry.

source.description: Where the dataset was or would be obtained from -- a canonical URL, DOI, or publisher name. Never a description alone.

license.description: The dataset's actual license identifier or name (e.g. 'CC BY 4.0', 'ODC-BY'). 'unknown' is a valid but honest value -- never left blank to imply a permissive default.

permitted_uses.description: Which of this project's public-data use categories the dataset's own license/terms actually permit. Never inferred from 'it is downloadable' -- see docs/DATA_POLICY.md.

speaker_metadata_restrictions.description: Any restriction on using or exposing per-speaker identity from this dataset (e.g. 'anonymized speaker IDs only, no PII', 'consented for research use only'). Null only if the dataset genuinely carries no speaker metadata at all.

provenance.description: How/when this dataset was acquired and by what process -- distinct from `source` (where it comes from).

checksum_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the acquired archive/manifest, recorded where practical. Null when not yet computed.

status.description: 'registered' records metadata only and grants no usage rights by itself -- 'approved' is the only status that clears the license/provenance gate.
